facilityDetails.programFocus: The Rural Adult Program (RAP) provides training and support in self-care, communication, community awareness, recreation/leisure activities, and vocational development to help people with developmental disabilities maximize their independence. RAP uses person-centered planning for individualized goals, with most activities occurring in the community.

parentReviews: The Rural Adult Program serves adults with developmental disabilities in rural Mendocino County.
It focuses on community integration, independent living, and vocational training.
The parent organization, UVAH, is CARF accredited and a nonprofit since 1961.

facilityDetails.programFocus: Enhanced Services offers a higher level of support for individuals requiring physical assistance or therapeutic intervention. Operating at a 1:2 staff ratio, this program ensures participants receive personalized, compassionate care—whether at home or in the community.
facilityFeatures: On-site therapies including physical therapy and speech
activitiesOffered: On-site therapies including physical therapy and speech

parentReviews: Enhanced Services offers specialized support for adults with significant needs, including physical assistance and therapies.
The program maintains a 1:2 staff ratio for personalized care and is CARF accredited.

facilityDetails.programFocus: Community Connection is a person-centered, community-based program that empowers individuals with developmental disabilities to build meaningful relationships, explore their interests, and become more engaged in everyday community life. The program emphasizes inclusion, self-expression, and personal growth by supporting participants in pursuing activities that align with their unique goals and values.

parentReviews: The Community Connection is a licensed adult day program in Fort Bragg, CA, for adults with developmental disabilities.
It offers inclusive, community-based activities focused on social connection, self-advocacy, and personal growth.
As a non-profit, it empowers individuals to build relationships and engage in everyday community life.
